title: Neon Slope 3D
description: Steer a high-speed neon ball down an endless procedural sci-fi slope. Dodge red hazard blocks, hit acceleration pads, and compete for the highest score!
controls: A / D or Left / Right: Steer Ball

title: 2048 Deluxe
description: Join the numbers to reach the legendary 2048 tile! Smooth sliding tile puzzle with undo moves, combo multiplier, and local high score tracking.

title: Cyber Snake Neon
description: Guide the glowing cyber serpent across a dark digital grid. Collect energy bits, avoid walls and your growing tail, and trigger turbo speed boosts.

title: Tetra Blocks
description: The ultimate falling blocks challenge. Features 7-bag randomizer, ghost block projection, hold queue, hard drop, and neon line-clear combos.

title: Flappy Pixel Wings
description: Flap through endless pipe gates in this arcade test of nerves and rhythm. Collect bronze, silver, gold, and platinum medals.
controls: Spacebar / Up Arrow / Click: Flap Wings

title: Galaxy Defender
description: Command Earth's starfighter against relentless waves of alien armada. Use bunker shields for cover and destroy high-value motherships.
controls: Arrow Left / Right or A / D: Move Ship

title: T-Rex Chrome Runner
description: The classic browser offline game upgraded! Run across desert dunes, leap over thorny cacti, duck under pterodactyls, and survive day/night cycles.

title: Neon Breakout DX
description: Smash crystalline neon bricks with high-velocity pulse spheres. Collect powerups including laser blasters, multiball, and wide energy paddles.
controls: Mouse / Arrow Left & Right: Move Paddle

title: Retro Pong AI & 2-Player
description: Play the legendary paddle duel against an intelligent adaptive AI or plug in a second player for head-to-head local multiplayer action.

title: Cyber Sweeper
description: Clear quantum minefields with logic and deduction. Choose Beginner (9x9), Intermediate (16x16), or Expert (30x16) with flag marking and timer.
